location.value: Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark
location.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark
location.notes: Three centres named: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus), Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg).

subject_id.notes: No explicit per-participant subject IDs given in text; only aggregate cohort (n=77 AN, n=70 HC) or ordinal descriptions of 6 FMT donors are reported.

sample_id.notes: No explicit sample/biospecimen identifiers given for individual participants or the 6 FMT donors.

subcohort.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain
subcohort.notes: Applies only to the 3 AN fecal donors used for FMT, captured in samples array; not a whole-cohort constant.

control.notes: Varies per sample (Case for AN, Study Control for HC); captured in samples array.

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark

body_site.evidence_quote: shotgun metagenomics on faecal samples from 77 female AN cases

age.notes: Varies per sample; captured in samples array for the 6 FMT donors. Overall cohort ages reported only in aggregate (Supplementary Table 2, not visible).

age_group.notes: Varies per sample; captured in samples array.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Derived: recent antibiotic/antifungal use was an exclusion criterion for both AN and HC groups, implying no current antibiotic use at enrollment.

bmi.notes: Varies per sample; captured in samples array for the 6 FMT donors. Aggregate cohort BMI reported in Supplementary Table 1/2 (not visible in provided text).

disease.notes: Cohort is mixed AN cases / healthy controls; disease status varies by sample and is captured per-row.

disease_details.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
disease_details.notes: Controls described as 'healthy weight (HC)' women; disease subtypes classified per DSM-5.

disease_response_orr.notes: Study is not a treatment-response/oncology study; ORR not applicable or reported.

disease_response_pfs.notes: Not applicable to this study design.

disease_response_recist.notes: Not applicable; not an oncology/solid-tumor study.

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: there was no significant difference in bacterial cell counts between AN and HC or within subtypes of AN
feces_phenotype.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
feces_phenotype.notes: Measured via flow cytometry bacterial cell counting (Supplementary Fig. 7); exact counts reported only in Supplementary Table 1, not in main text.

fmt_id.evidence_quote: AN-T n = 10, HC-T, n = 10 examined over 3 independent experiments
fmt_id.notes: Group-level identifiers for mouse recipients of AN or HC fecal microbiota transplants, not individual sample IDs.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: we transplanted faecal microbiota from three randomly chosen AN-RS cases ... and three age-matched HC participants ... to three independent litters of female germ-free (GF) mice
fmt_role.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain and altered energy metabolism in mice
fmt_role.notes: Human AN/HC participants served as donors; GF mice were recipients, sampled after FMT procedure for phenotyping.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: This is an exclusion-criterion statement (birth control pills were an allowed exception), not a per-participant status indicator; actual usage not reported.

smoker.evidence_quote: covariates including age, smoking and multiple drug intake
smoker.section: Results — Associations between absolute bacterial abundance and bioclinical variables in AN
smoker.notes: Smoking is used only as a statistical covariate; specific smoking status categories (current/former/never) not reported.

treatment.evidence_quote: all out-patients were also enrolled in cognitive behavioural therapeutic treatment courses
treatment.notes: Medications deconfounded included selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines (Results/Methods); FMT performed only in the mouse arm of the study.

by_subgroup.AN: lower fasting glucose and insulin, higher HOMA-IR-derived insulin sensitivity, lower CRP
by_subgroup.AN-RS: higher serum insulin and lower insulin sensitivity than AN-BP

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: women with AN were much leaner, had lower fasting serum concentrations of glucose and insulin, higher insulin sensitivity
biomarker_name.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
biomarker_name.notes: Directionality reported, but exact numeric concentrations not given in main text (detailed in Supplementary Tables 1-2, not provided here).

biomarker_unit.notes: Units for glucose/insulin/CRP not stated in the main text excerpt provided.

biomarker_value.notes: Only qualitative direction (higher/lower) reported in main text; quantitative values reside in Supplementary Tables 1-2 not included in provided text.

disease_response_os.notes: Overall survival not assessed; only aggregate mortality rate per decade mentioned in intro as background literature, not a study outcome.

ecog_performance_status.notes: Not applicable; not an oncology performance-status study.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: Specific bacterial cell count values not reported in the available main text; only statistical non-significance (P>0.05) mentioned.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; not a tumor study.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Field not applicable; paper concerns anorexia nervosa gut microbiota, not tumor measurements.

uncurated_metadata.notes: No clearly separable extra metadata identified beyond schema fields.

study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier (e.g., author-year code) was explicitly stated in the provided text.

pmid.notes: PMID taken from provided paper_id field, not from in-text citation.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder with a high mortality.
target_condition.notes: Two clinical subtypes also described: restricting (AN-RS) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP).

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Same 3-month antibiotic exclusion also applied to healthy controls.

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: Specific commercial kit name not given; only IHMS standard operating procedure referenced.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)
sequencing_platform.notes: Maps to allowed value 'Ion Torrent Proton'.

host_species.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively, from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.
host_species.notes: Study also includes a mouse (germ-free Swiss Webster) FMT experiment; host_species field only allows single value, human cohort is the primary microbiome dataset source.

extraction_warnings: The main cohort (77 AN cases, 70 healthy controls) is reported only in aggregate (study-level) statistics, largely in Supplementary Tables 1-2 which were not included in the provided text; no per-participant rows for this cohort could be extracted.
Sample-level rows were constructed only for the 6 individual faecal donors (3 AN-RS, 3 HC) used for mouse FMT experiments, for whom individual age and BMI values were explicitly reported in Methods.

No explicit subject_id or sample_id strings were given for the 6 FMT donors in the text; these required fields were set to 'not_reported' rather than fabricated, despite the donors being described in an ordered list.

Ancestry was extracted as the verbatim phrase 'Danish Caucasian' from the Methods section describing the overall study inclusion criteria, applied uniformly to all participants including the 6 FMT donors by inference (not explicitly restated for the donors).
AN-RS subcohort label applies specifically to the 3 human AN donors used for FMT per the explicit statement 'three randomly chosen AN-RS cases'; HC donors have no reported subcohort.
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.

Batch 1 subgroups ['AN (Anorexia Nervosa, all cases)', 'AN-RS (restricting subtype)', 'AN-BP (binge-eating/purging subtype)', 'HC (Healthy Controls)', 'AN-T (mouse FMT recipients from AN donors)', 'HC-T (mouse FMT recipients from HC donors)'] differ from batch 0 []; kept batch 0.
Study is on anorexia nervosa gut microbiota, not oncology; most cancer-related schema fields (ORR, PFS, RECIST, TNM/AJCC staging, tumor size, ECOG, OS) are not applicable and marked not_reported.

Quantitative biomarker values (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP, cholesterol, etc.) are referenced only qualitatively in the main text; exact values likely reside in Supplementary Tables 1-2, which were not included in the provided text.

FMT-related fields (fmt_id, fmt_role) pertain to the mouse experimental arm transplanting human donor feces into germ-free mice; human donors were AN/HC participants, recipients were mice labeled AN-T/HC-T.
Smoking and birth control pill information appear only as covariates/exclusion criteria, not as explicit per-participant status values.
Disease subtype details (AN-RS, AN-BP) were treated as subgroup-level disease_details values since they represent clinically distinct eating disorder subtypes explicitly named in the paper.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.
study_name could not be determined from the provided text; no canonical author-year identifier was stated.
host_species field is singular but the study includes both human (AN/HC cohort) and mouse (FMT recipient) data; only 'Human' was selected as primary.
dna_extraction_kit not explicitly named; only IHMS SOP protocol mentioned.
pmid value was taken from the external paper_id tag, not from in-text content, so no verbatim evidence quote could be provided.
